subject: TidalPoint — request for CEO clearance on pricing + legal exceptions
messages:
From: Emily Park <e.park@tidalpoint.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: TidalPoint Legal <legal@tidalpoint.com>, Jordan Hale <j.hale@tidalpoint.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TidalPoint contract redline + pricing ask

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the performance numbers and the multi-region options. Legal has reviewed the draft and attached a redline (TidalPoint_Redline_v2.docx). Two items are blocking our sign:

1) Indemnity: Legal has asked that Redwood accept a broader indemnity to cover third-party claims arising from the product, not just IP (they are proposing language that is materially wider than our standard).
2) Liability cap: they have asked to remove the liability cap entirely for any data-related losses.
3) Commercial: to offset the greater contract risk they are requesting a 35% one-year discount and a fixed price for the pilot SOW.

We want to move quickly — can you confirm which of these are potential deal-breakers for Redwood and whether you can escalate? If we can get leadership sign-off on scope and pricing today, I can get legal to remove a few of the non-material asks and circulate for signature.

Attached: TidalPoint_Redline_v2.docx, TP_SOW-v1.pdf

Best,
Emily Park
VP, Partnerships 
TidalPoint

--

(Attachment stub: TidalPoint_Redline_v2.docx (docx), TP_SOW-v1.pdf (pdf))

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: TidalPoint contract redline + pricing ask

Laura / Marissa / Nikhil — forwarding TidalPoint's redline and commercial ask. Quick summary and ask below.

Summary:
- External asks: broadened indemnity, removal of liability cap for data losses, 35% one-year discount + fixed SOW price.
- Customer: mid-market SaaS (pilot -> enterprise). Deal motion shows potential $420k ARR if pilot converts this quarter.

My read: this is higher-than-normal legal risk (especially cap removal). Commercially attractive if we can protect ourselves contractually and limit the discount exposure.

Ask: 
- Legal (Laura): please provide a recommended counter-language and whether you need exec sign-off for any exception.
- Deal desk (Marissa): can you model the revenue impact and propose a commercial alternative (discount cadence, concession caps) that reduces risk?
- Nikhil: if legal and deal desk recommend a path that needs a leadership exception (liability cap increase or removal, or >25% discount), please advise whether you can sign off or want this elevated to CEO.

Attaching TidalPoint's redline — please review and send guidance.

Thanks,
David
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

(Attachment stub: TidalPoint_Redline_v2.docx (docx), TP_SOW-v1.pdf (pdf))

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: TidalPoint contract redline + pricing ask

David / team — reviewed the redline and annotated changes in Redline_annotated_by_Laura.docx. High-level legal position and suggested compromise below.

Legal analysis:
- Indemnity: Customer is proposing very broad indemnity that would expose us to third-party liability beyond IP. We should not accept an open-ended indemnity. Recommend narrowing to: (i) claims arising from Customer's use of the Service, (ii) third-party IP claims, and (iii) gross negligence/willful misconduct. Avoid accepting liability for general third-party claims unrelated to our deliverables.
- Liability cap: complete removal is unacceptable. Standard cap = the greater of $1,000,000 or 1x fees (12 months). Customer asks removal for data losses. Proposal: increase cap for data-related losses to 3x fees for the first 12 months, with a carve-out for gross negligence/intentional misconduct (uncapped). This is a material exception and requires exec sign-off.
- Warranty: propose to retain standard warranty language but add a limited data-integrity SLA remedy (credit-based, capped).

Fallback options for leadership (ranked):
1) Approve temporary increase to 3x fees for data-related losses + 30% one-year discount tied to pilot acceptance. (Recommended — balances commercial/technical risk)
2) Decline liability-cap removal; offer 15% discount + technical remediation SLAs.
3) Walk away.

I've included suggested redline text in the document. If leadership wants the 3x cap route, we need explicit written sign-off from the CRO or CEO due to precedent risk.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

(Attachment stub: Redline_annotated_by_Laura.docx (docx))

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: TidalPoint contract redline + pricing ask — commercial options

Team — ran the numbers against our quota/discount policy and customer lifetime projection. Quick commercial proposals below (numbers are one-time / first-year impact):

Option A (Laura rec): 30% one-year discount for pilot + 3x-fees liability cap for data losses (exec sign-off required). Estimated near-term ARR hit: $147k (one year); Lifetime value unchanged if pilot converts.

Option B (Conservative): 15% discount + technical remediation SLA and 6-month financial holdback escrow for sensitive integrations. ARR impact: $73k. No exec exception required if legal accepts narrow indemnity.

Option C (Aggressive): 35% discount and full pilot fixed-price as requested but with a 12-month renewal price step-up of 20% — requires CEO approval and expressed legal carve-outs. Near-term impact: $171k; higher churn risk.

Recommendation: pursue Option A if leadership can accept the 3x-fees cap for data losses. It maximizes likelihood of closing the pilot while limiting long-term precedent. If leadership declines, Option B is an acceptable fallback and keeps our legal posture intact.

DocuSign link for standard amendment if we go Option A: https://app.docusign.com/TP-044

Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: TidalPoint contract redline + pricing ask — commercial options

David / team — thanks for the clear options and legal framing. I authorize Option A with the following explicit conditions:

1) Liability cap: increase to 3x fees for data-related losses only, capped at $1.5M absolute maximum for the entire contract term; carve-out for gross negligence/intentional misconduct remains uncapped per Laura's suggestion.
2) Indemnity: accept narrowed indemnity limited to IP, data breaches caused by Redwood, and claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence/willful misconduct. Do not accept broader third-party claim language.
3) Discount: approve 30% discount for the first year of the pilot only. Renewal pricing to be no less than standard list pricing + mandatory 10% step-up.
4) Controls: require a security attestation and a quarterly executive review during the pilot.

This approval should be documented in an email thread and attached as the 'Executive Exception Approval' on the deal record. David, proceed to instruct the customer and have legal prepare the amendment for signature. Use the DocuSign link provided by Marissa once redline is complete.

Nikhil Sharma
Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)
Redwood Inference
